evidence.claim: The president serves a five-year term with only one reelection, is supreme commander of the armed forces, may declare war/make peace and conclude treaties with DPR approval, appoints and dismisses ministers, and can be removed only through the constitutional impeachment process.
evidence.title: The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, Indonesia
evidence.excerpt: The president serves a five-year term with only one reelection, is supreme commander of the armed forces, may declare war/make peace and conclude treaties with DPR approval, appoints and dismisses ministers, and can be removed only through the constitutional impeachment process.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official constitutional text on an authoritative legal database; stable and directly governing 2022 office powers.
evidence.period_fit: Standing constitutional framework in force throughout 2022.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Office-level authority and constraints for Jokowi as president; not a performance claim.
contrary_evidence: No nuclear-specific authority appears in the text; it defines general executive powers, not nuclear command.
Several core powers are constrained by DPR and judicial procedures.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said the constitution already regulates presidential terms and that everyone must obey it, in response to three-term talk.
evidence.title: Soal Presiden Tiga Periode, Presiden Jokowi: Kita Harus Taat Konstitusi
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said the constitution already regulates presidential terms and that everyone must obey it, in response to three-term talk.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential statement published by the Cabinet Secretariat on the same day.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 ruler statement during the term-extension controversy.
contrary_evidence: Self-reporting is not independent verification of broader coalition behavior.
It rejects three-term talk but does not by itself show long-term institutional restraint.

evidence.claim: Jokowi said the 2024 election schedule was already fixed and that the government should prevent speculation about postponing the election or extending the president’s term.
evidence.title: Introductory Remarks of President of the Republic of Indonesia at Limited Cabinet Meeting on the Preparation for the 2024 Simultaneous General Elections and Regional Elections
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi said the 2024 election schedule was already fixed and that the government should prevent speculation about postponing the election or extending the president’s term.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential remarks published by the Cabinet Secretariat with explicit dates and policy context.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 statement during the term-extension debate.
contrary_evidence: This addresses constitutional timing, not nuclear or existential-risk policy.
It shows rejection of postponement speculation, not a broader institutional reform program.

evidence.claim: Jokowi instructed officials to anticipate global food and energy crises, manage subsidies and inefficiencies, and keep domestic prices stable during global uncertainty.
evidence.title: Presiden Jokowi Instruksikan Jajaran Antisipasi Krisis Pangan dan Energi
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi instructed officials to anticipate global food and energy crises, manage subsidies and inefficiencies, and keep domestic prices stable during global uncertainty.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct government transcript of Jokowi’s cabinet instructions with dated context and concrete policy guidance.
contrary_evidence: This is broad economic crisis management, not a nuclear-risk decision.
It supports end-posture context more than any nuclear-specific lens.

evidence.claim: Jokowi called for ending the war in Ukraine immediately and said war benefits nobody; leaders bear responsibility to create conditions for peace.
evidence.title: War in Ukraine Must be Stopped: President Jokowi
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi called for ending the war in Ukraine immediately and said war benefits nobody; leaders bear responsibility to create conditions for peace.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Direct presidential remarks published by the Cabinet Secretariat shortly after the summit appearance.
evidence.period_fit: Direct 2022 crisis-de-escalation statement during the Ukraine war.
contrary_evidence: Not nuclear-specific, so it is only indirect evidence for 1B.2/1B.8.
It is a generic antiwar statement, not a command or treaty action.

evidence.claim: BAPETEN said its task is to ensure nuclear use is only for peaceful purposes and to protect nuclear materials and installations; in 2022 it developed inspection procedures for planned and built SMR and MSR facilities.
evidence.title: Preparation of Standard Operating Procedure for Physical Protection October 25, 2022
evidence.excerpt: BAPETEN said its task is to ensure nuclear use is only for peaceful purposes and to protect nuclear materials and installations; in 2022 it developed inspection procedures for planned and built SMR and MSR facilities.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official regulator statement dated in 2022, with concrete nuclear-security and inspection content.
evidence.ruler_attribution: State regulatory system under Jokowi’s government; not a weapon-command decision.
contrary_evidence: This concerns civilian nuclear safety/security, not weapons policy.
It shows capacity-building and precaution, not a demonstrated existential-risk crisis choice by Jokowi.

evidence.claim: Jokowi signed PP No. 52/2022, which requires safety analyses for nuclear-material mining and formal declarations that firms will not work in service of nuclear arms.
evidence.title: Govt lays groundwork for uranium mining, broader atomic aspirations
evidence.excerpt: Jokowi signed PP No. 52/2022, which requires safety analyses for nuclear-material mining and formal declarations that firms will not work in service of nuclear arms.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reputable independent reporting that quotes the president’s action and summarizes the new regulation’s concrete obligations.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Jokowi attribution in the article.
contrary_evidence: This is civilian nuclear-material regulation, not an arms program.
The article is journalistic synthesis of the regulation, not the legal text itself.

evidence.claim: PP No. 52/2022 regulates safety, security, and management across all stages of nuclear-mineral mining and imposes administrative sanctions for security violations.
evidence.title: PP No. 52 Tahun 2022
evidence.excerpt: PP No. 52/2022 regulates safety, security, and management across all stages of nuclear-mineral mining and imposes administrative sanctions for security violations.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official regulation database with the enacted text summary and promulgation metadata.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Government/regulatory act under Jokowi’s administration; the page itself does not name the signer.
contrary_evidence: This is regulatory safety law, not evidence of weaponization or nuclear escalation.
It mainly shows civil nuclear governance and enforcement capacity.
